text:
maria: Quick flag  customer reported apparent double billing when a streaming session invoked a toolcall and then reconnected. ledger shows tool charge twice even though tool executed once.

sam: Can you drop the request id + a minimal repro?

maria: req: r-xc12. Sequence: open stream -> toolcall at token 95 -> connection drop -> reconnect resume -> stream emits suffix. Server logs: tool executor shows single run, router/ledger show two tool charge events.

josh: Do we set tool_call.id on the request? if we rely on session id for attribution, resume could re-attach and generate a new attach event.

maria: We do set "tool_call.id": "tool-xc12". Here's a sanitized snippet:
```json
{
  "stream_id": "s-77",
  "session_id": "sess-1",
  "tool_call": {"id": "tool-xc12", "name": "enrich", "args": {}}
}
// reconnect set session_id -> sess-2 and router re-attaches prefix + toolcall
```

ana: From console side, provisional charges were visible alongside a confirmed charge. Users see duplicates and open tickets. can we collapse UI dupes?

sam: Options:
- router fix: on resume, check recent-toolcall cache for (customer, tool_call.id) and skip re-attach if found (correct but adds a cache lookup on resume path)
- ledger dedupe: post-process billing entries and squash duplicates by (customer, tool_call.id, prox_time_window)
- UI-only: hide provisional entries when a matching confirmed exists (fast but masks root cause)

josh: Router approach seems most correct. We do need a lightweight in-memory cache with TTL so normal flows unaffected. Also add an "attach_emitted" flag to router telemetry so we can count dedupes.

maria: Another wrinkle: truncation. If server truncates tool output mid-token due to max_tokens, internal fragment accounting sometimes creates different token counts on resume, leading to mismatch between what user saw and what ledger recorded. We should bill only for tokens actually delivered to the client, and ensure resumed fragments map to same token boundaries.

sam: Agree. Action plan:
1) maria attach traces for r-xc12 (router events + ledger emits)
2) quick router PR to consult small TTL cache before emitting attach on resume
3) ledger alert rule to mark suspected duplicate tool charges for manual reconcile (BILL team)
4) console change to suppress provisional duplicates until confirmed or reconciled
5) create a short doc defining "billing token source of truth = emitted token boundaries" so truncation fragments handled consistently

josh: I'll add metrics: router.attach_attempts, router.attach_deduped, ledger.duplicate_tool_alerts. Add a dashboard card showing dupes over time.

maria: filing a customer-facing note and PMFY postmortem. Also linking BILL-4921.

billing-bot: Alert BILL-4921 created: "Potential duplicate toolcall charges on resume patterns". Threshold: 5 occurrences in 1h.

ana: Small UX copy change: make provisional hover text clearer: "Provisional: may merge with earlier charges if they correspond to same tool call".

maria: thanks all. will follow up with traces and a draft PR. :thumbsup:
